summary: Innventure, Inc. filed an 8-K on October 6, 2026, disclosing an At The Market Offering Agreement with Lucid Capital Markets, LLC, under which the Company may sell up to $60,000,000 of common stock (INV) from time to time as an at-the-market offering under Rule 415(a)(4). Lucid acts as sales agent or principal; agent commissions are 3.0% on the first $15,000,000 of gross sales and 2.17% thereafter. The Company intends to use net proceeds for working capital and general corporate purposes, including its strategic transformation. This is an ordinary shelf/ATM takedown, not a special situation. Watch dilution pace and pricing pressure.
